Perks

Read the effect, find its original car and build around it.

Builds

  • BuildsCar + ORIGINAL perk + one INSTALLED perk + SHIFT setup.
  • PERKULATORGive a familiar car another useful ability.

Perks

  • CLEAN EXITcommonA clean DRIFT, one that ends without hitting a wall or spinning out, adds 1 CONTROL for a few seconds, up to 5/5.From Compact
  • TRACTIONrareShallow off-road driving causes much less slowdown, while deep off-road remains punishing.From AWD
  • DRIFT DEMONrareDRIFT builds during sustained DRIFT or LOCK, up to 5/5.From Sports Car
  • CARRY ONrareLOCK loses much less speed.From Van
  • DRIFTAGEepicDRIFT drains less speed, steering becomes more aggressive and the car can hold larger slip angles.From Vintage Racer
  • TWITCHY TURNYlegendaryDRIFT fills BOOST even faster than normal.From Rally Racer
  • APEX GRIPepicOVERCHARGE increases CONTROL and ACCELERATION beyond their ordinary limits.From Race Car
  • FULL TANKepicClean driving builds BOOST TANK up to 5/5 and fills it as you go.From SUV
  • TORQUEepicOVERCHARGE builds BOOST TANK to 5/5 and has a stronger KICK.From Truck
  • GRADUATEDlegendaryClean driving improves CONTROL, then ACCELERATION, then TOP SPEED.From Learner Car
  • OVERSIZEDlegendaryGoing off-road doesn’t slow it down.From Monster Truck
  • DOUBLE SHIFTlegendarySHIFT moves 2 points between attributes instead of 1.From Sedan
  • OVERDRIVElegendaryThe longer you drive fast and clean, the higher the speed cap becomes. Leaving the track or colliding resets it.From Future Racer
  • FLOW SHIFTlegendaryAt FLOW ×3 or higher, SHIFT adds its three attribute points without reductions. SHIFT again moves the boost to the other three attributes.From Supercar
  • SIRENSlegendaryBoost activates flashing emergency lights and sirens.From Fire Truck · Police Car · Ambulance
  • SMVlegendaryA Slow-Moving Vehicle that’s not much to look at. Which makes it ideal for blank screen and non-visual driving practice.From Tractor
